**DTI:** 28.7% (housing $2,166 + student loan $420) ÷ $9,000 income = 28.7% — under 50% DU limit (B3-6-02). ✓  
**Funds to close:** $99,903 (down payment $90,000 + closing costs $9,903). Borrower has $108,699 own funds — sufficient. ✓  
**Reserves:** 2–4 unit principal residence requires 6 months PITIA (B3-4-1-01). Own funds after closing: $108,699 – $99,903 = $8,796 ÷ $2,166 = **4.06 months** — **insufficient**.  
**Gift:** $48,000 from “interested party.” B3-4.3-04: donor may not be an interested party (seller, builder, agent, etc.). Exception only if seller is also an acceptable donor (relative/familial) and not a builder/developer/agent. File lists relationship as “interested party,” not a relative — **ineligible gift**. IPCs cannot fund reserves or down payment (B3-4.1-02).  
**Credit:** Score 713, no bankruptcy/foreclosure — eligible. ✓  

Without the ineligible gift, reserves fall short of the 6-month requirement. No other funds are available.

DECISION: decline  
RULES: B3-4.1-01, B3-4.3-04, B3-4.1-02
